text: The Patriots will head to Miami for Week 8 significantly shorthanded at skill positions, with A.J. Brown ruled out due to ankle and knee injuries after missing the final two practices of the week, and running back TreVeyon Henderson sidelined by an illness—a double blow that forced the team to sign RB Lan Larison to the active roster and elevate WR Ryan Miller from the practice squad to provide depth. Brown's absence is particularly notable given that he'd just returned from injured reserve before suffering what appears to be a new knee ailment on top of his existing ankle issue, creating uncertainty around his availability going forward. The Dolphins will look to capitalize on their opportunity against a Patriots team forced to shuffle its offense, with most of Miami's current roster lacking extensive experience in this particular matchup.
